name: Self Gratification
overview: Scripture calls believers to reject self gratification by presenting their bodies as living sacrifices, holy and acceptable to God, rather than indulging in the lusts of the flesh. Walking honestly and in the Spirit enables Christians to avoid the sinful behaviors identified as works of the flesh, such as fornication and lasciviousness. The Bible warns that God is not mocked, and the choices one makes in yielding to fleshly desires will result in corresponding consequences. Instead, believers are urged to have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but to expose and reprove them.
